info.title: KryptaPay API
info.description:
Collect and pay out across Africa — Mobile Money, bank transfers and stablecoins — through one REST API.

Authenticate every request with your secret API key: `Authorization: Bearer kp_<env>_…`.
All responses use the envelope `{ "ok": boolean, "data"?: …, "error"?: { "code", "message", "details"? } }`.

post.description:
Charges a customer's Mobile Money wallet directly. Depending on the operator, the response tells you what the customer must do next:

- **Phone prompt** (most operators) — `checkoutUrl` is `null`; the customer approves on their phone with their PIN.
- **Operator redirect** (e.g. Wave, Djamo, Orange Money Senegal) — redirect the customer to `checkoutUrl`; they come back to your `redirectUrl`.
- **Code** (Orange Money Côte d'Ivoire and Burkina Faso) — `otpRequired` is true: show `otpInstructions` and send the code to [Confirm a payin with a code](/api-reference/payins/confirm-otp).

The payin starts as `PENDING`; listen for the `PAYIN_RECEIVED` / `PAYIN_FAILED` webhooks or poll [Get a payin](/api-reference/payins/get).

In sandbox the payin is simulated and returns `COMPLETED` immediately.

**API key scope:** `payins:write`

amount.description: Decimal amount with up to 8 fractional digits, e.g. "1500" or "1500.75"

network.description: Mobile Money network to charge. Must match `currency`.

msisdn.description: MSISDN, local or international format (digits only or with a leading "+"), e.g. "97000000", "22997000000", or "+22997000000". The wallet that will be charged.

redirectUrl.description: Where the operator sends the customer back after an operator redirect (`checkoutUrl`).

expiresInSec.description: How long the customer has to approve the payment, in seconds (60 to 86400).

amount.description: Decimal amount with up to 8 fractional digits, e.g. "1500" or "1500.75"

checkoutUrl.description: Operator page to redirect the customer to, for operators that need it. `null` when the customer approves on their phone.

otpRequired.description: True when the operator needs a one-time code from the customer to confirm the payment.

otpInstructions.description: Text to show the customer explaining how to obtain the code.

post.summary: Confirm a payin with a code
post.description:
Completes a payin whose creation returned `otpRequired: true` (e.g. Orange Money Côte d'Ivoire and Burkina Faso).
Show the customer `otpInstructions`, collect the code they generate on their phone, then send it here.

On success the payin moves to `PROCESSING`; the final result arrives by webhook. Errors: `bad_status` (payin no longer `PENDING`), `otp_unsupported` (this payin doesn't use a code), `otp_failed` (wrong code or refused by the operator — let the customer generate a new code and retry).

**API key scope:** `payins:write`

otp.description: Code generated by the customer, as they typed it.

post.description:
Sends money from your wallet in `currency` to a recipient. The amount plus fee is reserved immediately.

Always send an `Idempotency-Key`: retrying with the same key returns the original payout instead of paying twice.
Listen for the `PAYOUT_COMPLETED` / `PAYOUT_FAILED` webhooks for the final result.

**API key scope:** `payouts:write`

amount.description: Decimal amount with up to 8 fractional digits, e.g. "1500" or "1500.75"

msisdn.description: MSISDN, local or international format (digits only or with a leading "+"), e.g. "97000000", "22997000000", or "+22997000000". Required for mobile money networks.

customerId.description: Your own identifier for this recipient.

bankName.description: Informational only today — no payment provider reads this field. Kept for display / forward-compatibility.

bankId.description: Informational only today — no payment provider reads this field. Use bankCode instead.

bankCode.description: Bank code identifying the recipient's bank. Required for BANK_NGN (along with accountNumber) — this is the field payment providers actually read for Nigerian bank transfers.

accountNumber.description: Recipient bank account number (e.g. Nigerian NUBAN). Required for BANK_NGN, along with bankCode.

recipient.description: Which fields are required depends on `network`: mobile money networks require msisdn; BANK_NGN requires accountNumber and bankCode; crypto networks (ETH/POLYGON/TRON) require address. Every other bank rail (BANK_XOF, BANK_XAF, BANK_GHS, BANK_CDF, BANK_EUR, BANK_USD) is settled manually by KryptaPay today, so at least one recipient identifier is required but no specific field is enforced yet.

post.description:
Executes a conversion from your `from` wallet to your `to` wallet at the current rate. Both wallets must exist.

Send an `Idempotency-Key`: retrying with the same key returns the original conversion (`200`) instead of converting twice.

**API key scope:** `fx:write`

IdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key
IdempotencyKey.description: Unique key (a UUID is ideal) for this operation. Retrying with the same key returns the original result instead of creating a duplicate.

Unauthorized.description: Missing, invalid or expired API key.

Forbidden.description: The key lacks the required scope (`insufficient_scope`), or the account is not KYB-approved (`kyb_required`).

error.message: Your organization must complete KYB verification.

error.message: Rate limit exceeded, retry in 1 minute

UpstreamUnavailable.description: The payment operator could not process the request. Retry with backoff or use another network.
